summary: Codex successfully implemented a universal, cohesive WebTiles keybind badge and shortcut architecture. Visual presentation is standardized across Character Creation, Item Inspection, Inventory, HUD Toolbar, and Help overlays using `<kbd class='keybind-badge'>` with dark fantasy antique-gold styling. Input event dispatching, modifiers, and case sensitivity are accurately handled without event double-firing.

findings.notes: Introduced a dedicated AMD module providing `keyValue`, `label`, `badge`, `html`, `commandLabel`, `commandCode`, `matches`, `creationControls`, and `inspectionActions`. Cleanly handles named keys (Backspace, Tab, Enter, Escape, Space), Ctrl+Key chords, case sensitivity, and disabled state filtering.

Rebuilt species, background, and weapon choice hotkeys with `.keybind-badge`. Fixed Backspace navigation so it only appears on the weapon selection screen where backing up is valid. Preserved Tab saved-preset shortcut and '?' help toggle.
Action dock uses `keybinds.inspectionActions(desc)` with server-provided numeric keycodes across all item classes. Standardized Esc close button and removed cluttered duplicate brackets.
Replaced emojis with proper GUI tiles (`gui.CMD_*`), standardized the 'e' label to 'Equip Item' matching the engine's `CMD_EQUIP`, and cleaned up keyboard drawer routing using `keybinds.matches()`.

Unified tooltip hints with `tooltipLine()` across sidebar and modal inventory. Correctly renders slot key badges only on slots containing items. Preserved [L-Click], [R-Click] Describe, and [Shift + L-Click] Drop actions.

Replaced fragmented badge styles with unified `.keybind-badge` rule: antique-gold borders (`rgba(196, 154, 69, 0.4)`), deep charcoal background (`rgba(16, 17, 22, 0.9)`), crisp gold text (`#e5c158`), clear hover/focus states, and distinct line-through muted styling for disabled actions.

Created `keybind_system_test.js` covering 18 key mappings, modifier chords, character creation hotkeys, item inspection actions, and disabled states. 24/24 .ai-team unit tests and WebTiles Python tests pass.

recommendations: Proceed with pushing `feature/webtiles-keybind-system` to origin and opening a Pull Request targeting `main`.
